summary: The phase meets its outcome: the run exports TF_VAR_stage/TF_VAR_namespace from the Job's own arguments before init and apply alike, TF_VAR_cluster deliberately absent, and the precedence claim is proven against real Terraform rather than asserted. I re-ran all five mutations the done-record claims plus one of my own; every one bites, so the credential-chain reset, the two-volume reattach coverage and the two previously-vacuous assertions are real. One Minor advisory item — an empty stage/namespace argument still reaches Terraform as an empty TF_VAR_*, unreachable from a rendered Job.

findings.summary: An empty stage or namespace argument is exported verbatim as an empty TF_VAR_*, reproducing the silent misnaming P9 closes; the chart's required guard is what keeps it unreachable.
